About Us

Setting the standard for rural education in Pakistan

Founded by Syed Babar Ali and Family in collaboration with the Syedanwala Agriculture Farm & Packages Group, our school exists to prove that a child's postal code should never limit their potential. Every student who walks through our gates receives an education built to the same standard as Pakistan's finest institutions — free of charge.

Our mission is simple: provide world-class education, completely free, to the children of rural Punjab, and become a model that other communities can follow.

“A great nation is built not on what it takes from its people, but on what it gives back to its next generation.”

Syed Babar Ali Foundation
  • ✓Free breakfast & lunch daily
  • ✓Free uniform & textbooks
  • ✓Highly trained, dedicated faculty
  • ✓Educational tours & science fairs
Academics

Two campuses. One standard of excellence.

Separate Girls' and Boys' campuses offer classes from Grade 6 through Intermediate, with dedicated pre-medical, pre-engineering and computer-science tracks.

All Programs
Boys' Campus
01 · Middle

Grade 6–8

A strong foundation in sciences, mathematics, languages and Islamiyat, taught by trained subject specialists.

  • Core sciences & math
  • English & Urdu language
  • Computer literacy
02 · Secondary

Grade 9–Matric

Board-aligned Science and Computer Science groups preparing students for Intermediate placement and beyond.

  • Physics, Chemistry, Biology
  • Computer Science track
  • Career counselling
03 · Intermediate

FSc & ICS

Pre-Medical, Pre-Engineering and ICS groups, with rigorous test preparation for university entrance exams.

  • FSc Pre-Medical
  • FSc Pre-Engineering
  • ICS

Top 5 Pre-Medical students earn a LUMS scholarship.

Every year, our highest-achieving Intermediate Pre-Medical students are awarded scholarship placements at LUMS — one of Pakistan's leading universities.

Learn About Admission
Admission

Join Syedanwala Higher Secondary School

Admission is merit-based and completely free. Follow the steps below, then complete the online form to begin your application.

1

Submit the online form

Complete the admission form with student and guardian details.

2

Document verification

Bring previous school result, B-Form/CNIC and a passport photo for verification.

3

Entry test

Shortlisted students sit a merit-based entry test in Math, English and General Ability.

4

Result & enrollment

Successful candidates are enrolled free of cost, with uniform and books provided.

Important Dates

Form Submission Opens1 March
Form Submission Closes30 April
Entry Test15 May
Result Announcement30 May
Session Begins1 August

Dates are illustrative for this website and can be updated by the school administration each year.
